title: International Higher Diploma in Economics (Level 4)
description: Build a strong foundation in economic theory, quantitative analysis, and policy understanding to address real-world economic challenges in a global environment.
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and ISM Education
longDescription: The International Higher Diploma in Economics (Level 4) provides learners with a comprehensive introduction to economic principles, quantitative methods, and socio-economic analysis. The program develops an understanding of microeconomic concepts, economic theory, and the role of economics in shaping public and private sector decision-making. Students gain analytical, mathematical, and technological skills necessary for interpreting economic data and evaluating economic issues. The curriculum integrates economic knowledge with communication, critical thinking, and professional development competencies. This qualification prepares learners for higher-level studies and careers in economics, finance, business, public policy, and related fields. Programme Structure This program consists of compulsory units, which are equal to a total of 120 credits. Note: This course is delivered in partnership with an institution in Kazakhstan and is not available for online delivery.

* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.

outcomes: Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of fundamental economic theories, principles, and concepts that influence local, national, and global economies.
Analyze economic issues and market behavior using microeconomic frameworks and evidence-based reasoning.
Apply quantitative and mathematical techniques to solve economic problems and support decision-making processes.
Evaluate the impact of political, social, cultural, and environmental factors on economic development and public policy.
Utilize information and communication technologies to collect, analyze, interpret, and present economic information effectively.
Assess the role of ethical practices, sustainability, and governance in promoting economic growth and societal well-being.
Demonstrate effective communication, critical thinking, research, and professional skills required for progression to higher education and careers in economics and related disciplines.
